# Alpha Health Group

> Alpha Health Group is a leading healthcare consultancy in the United Arab Emirates. We empower hospitals, clinics, medical centers, and homecare providers with end-to-end support for DOH compliance, JCIA accreditation, healthcare quality assurance, facility licensing, and operational excellence across the GCC.

## Who We Are

Alpha Health Group (also known as Alpha Health Consultancies / Alpha TSM) provides strategic healthcare management consultancy to healthcare facilities across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and the wider UAE. Our expertise spans regulatory compliance, quality systems, engineering design approvals, and digital transformation for the healthcare sector.

## Areas of Expertise

DOH licensing, JCIA accreditation, DHA compliance, HAAD standards, healthcare facility setup, infection control, patient safety, healthcare quality KPIs, medical engineering approvals, hospital design and master planning, healthcare workforce resourcing, pharmaceutical and regulatory services.
